request: Impact Soft on App activation targets, including Home objects; twenty Light requests across each coin flight, coin-collect.mp3 at flight start; user further requires BGM to continue playing and cancels simulator verification

activationCoverage.additional: Four inline Text links/retry actions use the same synchronous acknowledgement; gesture-backed Squeeze/Bonk buttons use Soft

changes.activationContract: Accepted actions use Soft without awaiting it; disabled controls remain inert. Forward the original host/ref/layout/press-state/hitSlop and action return value. Deduplicate the same native event and synchronous legacy navigation/selection impacts; retain independent semantic outcomes and continuous interaction feedback.

coinFlight.implementation: One bounded absolute-deadline timer; only a new batch/flight starts it, not a receipt, merged reward, portal or balance update. Late slots are skipped, never caught up into a burst or played during the balance hold.

sound.preparation: Foreground silent preload; a not-yet-loaded clip is skipped rather than played late
sound.bgm: mixWithOthers, no ducking, no exclusive-focus acquisition, no pause/replacement/recreation of BGM. Audio-effect cleanup owns only its own player.
sound.privateAudio: Share the existing Surprise/private-playback focus state through a small non-UI registry, so effect preload/playback cannot overwrite recording/private playback audio mode.

changes.lifecycle: Respect App sound/haptics preferences. Background, identity change, cancellation and unmount release pending pulses/audio without replay on return. Reduce Motion with no visible coin flight does not start the flight sequence.
unchanged: Coin ledger, durable intents, claims, amounts and receipts
Touch Note recording/replay counting and continuous feedback
Ordinary Plushie hearts and fixed one-hour Moments aggregation
Room ownership, notifications and startup priority

targeted.bgmEvidence: Actual BGM gate/controller and coin-feedback hook share the audio boundary and private-focus registry. Three coin flights, completion and effect stop leave the same BGM player playing: one BGM play, zero pauses, no removal/recreation; no per-flight mode reset.

export.note: Final stable-source export succeeded. An earlier export started before the audio-focus module was created failed resolution; the final clean process resolves it normally. No resolver/runtime workaround.

verification.sdkInspection: Installed expo-audio 1.1.1: iOS deactivateSession only deactivates when no registered player is playing; setAudioMode does not pause players. Android MIX_WITH_OTHERS bypasses audio-focus acquisition. Runtime uses the same FOREGROUND_AUDIO_MODE as BGM.

native.status: Not accepted as verified; user explicitly cancelled simulator tests and will self-test
native.details: An isolated QA bundle was built. Desktop UI service could not start; no native click/visual/haptic/performance acceptance result is claimed. The QA launch attempt had no continuing process when cleanup was requested. No production account/API mutations, native dependency change or App publication.

verification.limits: Target suites overlap each other and the domain gate; counts are not additive. Mock/native-boundary checks and code exports do not prove physical haptic sensation, speaker loudness, every historical UI route or Android/iOS hardware behavior. No simulator acceptance or new FPS result claimed.

release: Client-only source update, applies after Metro reload with existing native dependencies. No API/database/R2 deployment, App publication, announcement, forced update or Git commit. Existing unrelated working-tree changes preserved.
